findings.title: [P2] Preserve API classification for the platform mutation fixtures
findings.body: Source `scripts/check-platform-surface-drift-mutations.mjs` writes a complete Kubernetes Ingress through `ingressFixture`, restores that Ingress through `ingressFixtureBefore`, and writes Kubernetes resources through the generic `after`/`before` mutation loop (including Service, CiliumNetworkPolicy and RBAC manifests). Renewing these non-api receipts causes the exact-match contract branch in `docs-api-output-role-classification.mjs` to accept those outputs as non-api. Their temporary location and mutation-test purpose do not change their Kubernetes API shape. Keep the known resource outputs API-classified and provide their actual discovery/adapter closure; split the heterogeneous generic writes rather than exempting every restored source body.

overall_explanation:
Partition 8 Source/native consumer decisions:
PASS scripts/check-suite-migration-workflow.mjs: selected success/failure streams are workflow diagnostics, including schema errors and failed child-proof output; repository manifests, receipts, external trust key and executable proofs remain mutable inputs, not qualified execution evidence.
NOT_READY scripts/check-platform-surface-drift-mutations.mjs: complete Source includes known Kubernetes resource writes and heterogeneous original-file restoration. Isolation/cleanup does not prove non-API shape; API discovery and adapters for these writes remain unproven.
PASS scripts/ap08-extension-inventory.mjs: manifest/role/guide/audit inputs produce a documentation inventory and Markdown consumed by documentation publication; selected caught errors are generation diagnostics.
PASS scripts/check-prism-guides.mjs: selected output contains mechanically derived counts, consumed as a CLI diagnostic. Git objects, guide/source files and configuration inventories remain mutable inspection inputs.
PASS skills/common/plugin-runtime/foundation/observability/attempt-projection.ts: selected canonical bytes are native attempt-store state; durable-attempt retirement supplies the fenced encoded snapshot, and replay resolves journal-bound result references and validates the reconstructed state.
PASS scripts/registry-client-config.mjs: constructors emit BuildKit TOML, runtime registry settings and private node registry configuration. Runtime entrypoint reads the generated settings; credentials are intentionally confined to private exclusive node output. Environment credentials and operator input are not receipt-qualified bytes.
PASS scripts/check-erasable-typescript.mjs: selected progress line is diagnostic text derived from discovered config paths; compiler/synchronizer subprocess effects are not qualified by this classification.
PASS scripts/lint-baseline-update.mjs: selected stdout is an update acknowledgement after report/baseline binding and fingerprint checks; baseline mutation is a separate native artifact effect.
PASS scripts/stateful-database-service.mjs: selected stdout is a native Service-name selection protocol, not general diagnostic prose. Chart acquisition/rendering, values and Helm are external/mutable dependencies; imported selections feed recovery/network-policy renderers whose Kubernetes outputs remain API surfaces.
PASS skills/nova/project/legacy-import-cli.ts: selected file is native project authoring data, structurally imported, compiled and runtime-validated before exclusive publication; the project CLI subsequently consumes it. Report/error streams are separate.
Scope: listed receipt refreshes only; no producer/check execution, tests, cluster activity, broad registry/gate acceptance, or communication/host-lifecycle checker review. PASS denotes selected source-level output purpose and consumer closure, not runtime input, byte or effect qualification.
